subject: ENG103
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English videos that are highly relevant and popular. Arabic coverage was challenging, with two topics having no eligible videos due to relevance or view count issues. For two other Arabic topics, proxy videos from related fields (marketing, scientific research) were chosen as the best available fit.

coverage.note: No candidates directly compared technical and academic writing; all failed the relevance gate.
Relevant candidates failed the view count gate; other candidates were about software/hardware features, not writing.
Selected a video on a specific document type (scientific research) as no videos covering multiple types were eligible.
Selected a highly popular marketing video as its explanation of audience and purpose is the best available proxy.

videos.title: English for academic and professional purposes introduction| Academic vs. Professional Writing| SHS
videos.filter_reason: A highly-viewed, concise comparison of academic and professional writing, which directly addresses the student's challenge of transitioning between styles.

videos.title: Types of Technical Writing
videos.filter_reason: Directly addresses the topic by covering various types of technical writing from a specialized channel, providing a broad overview.

videos.title: Characteristics of technical writing ! Qualities of good technical writing
videos.filter_reason: A short, direct, and popular video that clearly lists and explains the core characteristics of good technical writing.

videos.title: Editor Fixes Common Prose Mistakes (Part 1)
videos.filter_reason: A massively popular and practical video that demonstrates how to fix common prose mistakes, effectively teaching editing and proofreading strategies.

videos.title: Purpose, Audience, Form (P.A.F)
videos.filter_reason: A highly-viewed and comprehensive guide explaining the essential framework of Purpose, Audience, and Form in writing.

videos.title: كيف تسوي بحث علمي بكل شطارة
videos.filter_reason: A popular and concise guide on writing scientific research, a key type of technical document for university students.

videos.title: أخطاء الموظفين اللغوية في الكتب الرسمية
videos.filter_reason: An engaging and highly-viewed video that teaches proofreading by showing common linguistic errors in official documents.
